before_times: how many guests, and is everyone 18 or older
the service or package, and the massage length
for a couples booking or a party: each guest's service
after_time: pressure for each guest: light, medium or firm
for a visit at home or a hotel: the address, parking, the stairs, and a quiet room with space for the table
secure_page_only: each guest's own health form, filled in by that guest only: pregnancy, injuries or recent surgery, allergies (nuts, oils, scents, skin care), areas to avoid, skin treatments lately (retinoids, peels, waxing)
18 or older, or a parent's consent
the guest's own yes to how the health notes are used
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who signs the form and stays at the spa (and in the room for massage, where the state's rules require it)

stop.words: a reaction happening now to an oil or a skin product: a swelling face, lips or throat, or trouble breathing
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rinse the product off with cool water.

stop.words: chest pain, fainting or a fall during or after a treatment

go_on.words: pregnant, a recent injury or surgery, a fever, a rash or a skin infection
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the therapist reads the form first and may change the treatment (a prenatal massage, no work on that area), or the visit moves with no fee

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Health form (each guest's own, on the secure page)
steps.when: before the visit; good for 12 months, with a check for changes at each booking
steps.who: every guest, a second guest on their own link
steps.result: the therapist and esthetician read it before starting; not done in time: filled in on the desk's tablet at check-in

steps.name: A doctor's OK
steps.when: before massage in some cases the form names (a pregnancy with complications, a recent surgery)
steps.result: Sam OKs the booking once the guest says they have it

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: arrive 30 minutes early to check in and change; skip retinoids for 3 days before a facial; for a visit at home, a quiet room with space for the table

staff.skills: massage (Swedish, deep tissue, hot stones, prenatal) and facials and body treatments; only people with the skill and the license for a part are offered for it
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each person's massage or esthetics license per state, where the state's rules require it
staff.supervision: students and apprentices work only under a licensed provider, where the state's rules allow
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs each group booking of 3 or more guests, a booking with a past product reaction, and a doctor's OK when the form asks for one; every price is on the menu, so no price needs an OK
staff.stand_in: a stand-in needs the same skill and license, and gets the guest's form and notes; a swap is offered only when the guest didn't ask for someone by name; on a couples booking the other therapist is busy, so the stand-in is a third therapist (the example: Iris, who also covers the spa on Saturdays)

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who signs the form and stays at the spa (and in the room for massage, where the state's rules require it)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian
children_and_age.minors_rules: a parent's written consent for a minor, and a parent present for massage, where the state's rules require it

visit.check_in: at the spa: the check-in code at the front desk, one code for a couples booking; at a home or hotel: the code at the door
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the provider; notes for next time go in the guest's private record
visit.changes_at_visit: an add-on (hot stones, a scalp massage) is priced and OK'd before it's done
visit.before_work: each provider reads that guest's health form and asks about pressure before starting

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: switches from each state's form: a massage license for each person who gives massage, and an esthetics license for each person who gives facials and body treatments, where the state's rules require them
license.who: both: the spa holds its place license where one is required, and each therapist and esthetician holds their own
license.ask: the spa's license or registration number; each person's number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form or a hotel asks for it

never_in_a_text: health answers (pregnancy, injuries, allergies, skin treatments) never go in a text or through the AI: only each guest's secure page and the providers serving that guest; a staff text says only that a note exists
